Avoid movement of animals and free movement of people in banana plantation

Monitoring: Always monitor for the presence of symptoms after plantation establishment
Observe symptoms like wilting and yellowing of leaves, degeneration of male flower buds, premature ripening of banana fingers, occurrence of ooze on cut pseudostems
Once infection is noticed take action as soon as they are at early stage.
Direct Control: Infected plants should be removed as soon as they are noticed at early stage
At 70% of banana disease incidence, uproot the whole plantation and bury them
